symbols.name: TimeOnlyComparer
symbols.summary: Entity Framework Core value comparer for System.TimeOnly values to enable proper change tracking and caching behavior.
symbols.remarks: EF Core needs a Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.ChangeTracking.ValueComparer%601 for non-primitive types to determine if a property changed. This implementation compares the underlying System.TimeOnly.Ticks to provide fast, precise equality without culture or time zone concerns and supplies a stable hash code for dictionary/set usage. Usage example when configuring a property: builder.Property(e => e.StartTime) .HasConversion(new TimeOnlyConverter()) .Metadata.SetValueComparer(new TimeOnlyComparer());
